parameters.content:
## Agent #2: Lead Research

**Setup (5 minutes)**
1. Fill in every "FILL IN" value in **Config: Your Business**.
2. Optional: adjust **Config: Agent Settings**.
3. Open **Claude** and pick your Anthropic credential.
4. Open **Email Me the Briefs** and pick your Gmail credential.
5. Click **Publish** (**Activate** in older n8n versions), then use the production URL from **Paste Your Leads**.

The agent reads each lead's homepage and Google News headlines, then Claude writes a brief from only that material. Nothing is sent to your leads.

parameters.formDescription: One lead per line: Company | website | person (person is optional). You get a research brief on each lead by email.

values.placeholder:
Acme Plumbing | acmeplumbing.com | Dana Lee
Bright Dental | brightdental.co
Optional. Defaults to what you do in Config: Your Business.

values.formSubmittedText: Researching now. The briefs will arrive in your inbox in a few minutes.

assignments.name: what_you_do
assignments.value: FILL IN: One or two sentences on what you sell and who it helps

assignments.name: ideal_customer
assignments.value: FILL IN: Who you want to work with (industry, size, role)

assignments.name: tone_of_voice
assignments.value: Friendly, direct, plain English. No hype, no buzzwords.

assignments.name: email_signature
assignments.value: FILL IN: Your sign-off, e.g. Talk soon, Sam

assignments.name: opener_style
assignments.value: One or two sentences. Specific to them, based on the research. No flattery, no fake familiarity.

const decode = (s) => s
  .replace(/ /g, ' ')
  .replace(/"/g, '"')
  .replace(/'|'|'/g, "'")
  .replace(/</g, '<')
  .replace(/>/g, '>')
  .replace(/&/g, '&');
const lead = $('Split Leads').item.json;
const html = typeof $json.data === 'string' ? $json.data : '';
const text = decode(html
  .replace(/<script[\s\S]*?<\/script>/gi, ' ')
  .replace(/<style[\s\S]*?<\/style>/gi, ' ')
  .replace(/<[^>]+>/g, ' ')
  .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
  .trim())
  .slice(0, 5000);
return { json: { ...lead, site_text: text, site_found: text.length > 200 } };

messageValues.message:
=You research sales leads and write short, accurate briefs.
You work for {{ $('Config: Your Business').first().json.your_name }} at {{ $('Config: Your Business').first().json.business_name }}.
What they do: {{ $('Config: Your Business').first().json.what_you_do }}
Their ideal customer: {{ $('Config: Your Business').first().json.ideal_customer }}

Rules you always follow:
- Only use facts that appear in the input. If something is missing, say "Not found" or leave it out. Never invent names, numbers, dates, news, or quotes.
- Never promise results, revenue, savings, or timelines, and never make income claims.
- Write in this tone: {{ $('Config: Your Business').first().json.tone_of_voice }}
- Reply with JSON only, no extra text.
- Use only the website text and news headlines provided. If the website text is empty, say the site could not be read.
- A news item only counts if it is clearly about this company. Skip headlines about a different company with a similar name.
